observations.title: Read an effect's remaining duration visually
observations.player_action: Inspect an active effect in the HUD or inventory.
observations.outcome: A small bar visualizes remaining duration alongside the existing effect icon.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Reduce clutter and adjust effect bars
observations.player_action: Configure bar position/colors and automatic hiding for selected cases.
observations.outcome: Beacon-like refreshes or very long effects can be hidden to reduce clutter.
conditions: Styling does not change server effect duration; the source advertises Stylish Effects compatibility from 1.0.2.
